data.title: Data entities
data.subtitle: The logical data the processes create, read, update and delete.
data.empty: No data entities yet. Add the first one.
data.numberMinted: The DE number is assigned when you save.
data.name: Entity name
data.reloaded: Reloaded the latest version. Your changes are still in the form: check them and save again.
data.retireEntityBody: {label} will be retired. It can be restored later. An entity that still has fields or requirement links cannot be retired.
data.retiredBanner: This entity is retired. Restore it to edit it or its fields.
data.check.fkNoField: Foreign key without a target field: {names}
data.check.fkAllFields: Every foreign key names its target field
data.usedByNone: No requirement uses this entity yet.
data.field.name: Field name
data.field.groupHelp: Relationship numbers are assigned by the system. Choose an existing one only to build a key of several fields.
data.field.duplicate: This entity already has a field with that name.
data.field.retireBody: {name} will be retired. A field that another field's foreign key points at cannot be retired.
data.field.gone: This field was retired by someone else. Close and reload the page.
data.field.reloaded: Reloaded the latest version. Your changes are still in the form: check them and save again.
data.loadFailed: Could not load this. Reload the page to try again.
data.check.unavailable: Checks appear once the fields have loaded.
data.erd.title: Entity relationship diagram
data.erd.subtitle: The logical model as drawn from the declared keys. Relationships come only from foreign-key fields, so the diagram is exactly as complete as the model.
data.erd.empty: No data entities in this scope yet.
data.erd.emptyArea: No process under this node reads or writes a data entity yet.
data.erd.help: Drag a card to place it; the place is saved for everyone. Click a card to highlight its neighbours, double-click to open the entity.
data.erd.helpReadOnly: Click a card to highlight its neighbours, double-click to open the entity. You can view this diagram but not rearrange it.
data.erd.arrangeHelp: Re-arranges every card that was never placed by hand. Nothing is saved.
data.erd.resetBody: Every saved card position on this diagram is removed, and so is every collapse or expand choice: cards go back to their default size and are arranged automatically. Entities and fields are not changed. Other subject areas keep their own layouts.
data.erd.noKeyHelp: This entity has no primary-key field yet.
data.erd.collapse: Show fewer fields. This saves the card's current place too, which pins it there.
data.erd.expand: Show all fields. This saves the card's current place too, which pins it there.
data.erd.collapseLocal: Show fewer fields (only on your screen)
data.erd.expandLocal: Show all fields (only on your screen)
data.erd.table.none: No relationships in this scope. A relationship appears when a field is marked as a foreign key.
data.erd.layoutFailed: The diagram could not be arranged: {message}
